findings.title: A teacher display name containing an unclosed bidi override (U+202E) garbles the whole "Reviewed by ... (teacher #id) · date" audit line, reversing the date and the id suffix
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r12-C/tbidi_t.mjs, screenshot /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r12-C/shots/bidi_content_desk.png. Registered teacher "Prof Bidi\u202e" (201), reviewed hem-01; the row reads "Reviewed by Prof BidiMP 93:4 ,6202 ,8 tcO · (921# rehcaet)" instead of "... (teacher #129) · Oct 8, 2026, 4:39 PM". API value is intact: reviewedBy "Prof Bidi\u202e (teacher #129)".
findings.repro: Register a teacher (invite code) named "Prof Bidi" + U+202E, move any mission draft -> reviewed, open Content review.
findings.expected: The reviewer label, its (teacher #id) disambiguator and the timestamp stay readable whatever the name contains.
findings.actual: The unclosed override leaks out of the name into the rest of the line (ReviewTrail renders the name as plain text in the same inline run as the id suffix and the <time>). The unambiguous part of the audit record is the part that becomes unreadable. names.ts folds bidi characters for comparison only, validate() accepts them for display.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx ReviewTrail (~line 290): wrap the name in <bdi> (or an isolate span) so it cannot affect neighbours; be/src/http.ts / names.ts: reject or strip \p{Bidi_Control} (U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069, U+200E/F, U+061C) in display names.

findings.area: All page-level error panels (Faculty, Student detail, Content review, also student pages via ErrorPanel/Loaded)
findings.title: After a keyboard Retry on a failed page load succeeds, focus falls to <body>: the Retry button is unmounted while the panel switches to the loading state and nothing re-places focus
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r12-C/tfocus2.mjs: Faculty, Student detail and Content review each print "after Retry focus: BODY". By contrast the settings banner Retry and the Content-review stale-list Retry (round 10/11 fixes) correctly land on the h1.
findings.repro: Make GET /classes/*/analytics (or /students, /content/missions) answer 500, open the page, focus Retry, press Enter after the route is lifted.
findings.expected: Same behaviour as the other Retry buttons: focus lands on the page h1 once the content is there.
findings.actual: document.activeElement is <body>; a keyboard or screen-reader user restarts from the top of the page.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/ui/state.tsx Loaded/ErrorPanel + useLoad: remember that the retry came from the panel and focus main h1 when the load settles (reuse focusHeadingWhenReady in shell.tsx).

findings.area: describeError on every faculty surface, profile banner, content PUT
findings.title: Empty-bodied 400/409/413/422/418 (and any other 4xx except 403/404/429) still show the raw "Request failed (n)"; an empty 429 with a Retry-After header ignores the header
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r12-C/t6b.mjs + modes2.mjs, output /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r12-C/t6b.out (184 faculty scenarios: 40 rows read "Faculty view unavailable Request failed (400|409|413|422|418)"), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r12-C/tban.mjs (settings banner, both roles) and PUT status ("Could not update the status: Request failed (413)"). 403/404/429/5xx empty bodies are fine and real server sentences pass through everywhere; every scenario gave exactly one role=alert with a working Retry.
findings.repro: Route any faculty GET (or PUT /content/missions/*/status) to status 413 or 400 with an empty body (what a reverse proxy sends).
findings.expected: A sentence a teacher can act on, as for 5xx ("The request was refused, please retry").
findings.actual: The round-11 fix only covers 403, 404, 429 and >=500.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/ui/state.tsx describeError: add a final fallback for serverSentence()===undefined (4xx), and read the retry-after header in api.ts errorFrom for empty 429s.

findings.area: Faculty / Content review after a change whose reply was lost AND the re-read fails
findings.title: Two simultaneous alerts, and after the stale-list Retry succeeds the first alert stays ("Could not confirm the status change: The server had a problem. Please retry.") without the sentence saying the list now shows the recorded state
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r12-C/tcr.mjs e502|abortApplied|badjson200 reread: alerts = [Could not confirm..., The list could not be refreshed...]; after Retry the first alert remains (shown flag never set by refreshList). "Please retry" is also advice to repeat a change that was in fact applied.
findings.repro: PUT status applied then answered 502, every later GET /content/missions 503; click Retry once the GET works again.
findings.expected: Retry success replaces the message with "The list below shows what the server recorded."; one alert at a time.
findings.actual: Stale alert; row shows the real status (server and UI agree), so wording only.
findings.fix_hint: web/src/pages/faculty.tsx refreshList (~line 320): setProblem(p => p && {...p, shown:true}) on success; drop "Please retry" for the unconfirmed case.
